_comment: Hand-maintained donation/volunteer info for the winter page. Every entry needs a source_url and a checked date (YYYY-MM-DD) set by a human who confirmed it. Plain text only. Never add a payment link or account number you have not confirmed with the organization itself.

entries.name: Ellensburg Cold Weather Shelter (Grace Episcopal Church, 1201 N B St)
entries.how_en: Volunteers, catered meals and food donations help run the shelter. The page does not list a donation phone or link; ask the City of Ellensburg Housing Program Manager.
entries.how_es: Los voluntarios, las comidas donadas y las donaciones de alimentos ayudan a operar el refugio. La página no da un teléfono ni un enlace para donar; pregunta a la gerente del programa de vivienda de la Ciudad de Ellensburg.

entries.name: Rod's House (Yakima, young adults and youth)
entries.how_en: Warm clothing (coats, hand warmers, socks) and food have been requested in past winters. Needs may have changed — contact them first.
entries.how_es: En inviernos pasados han pedido ropa abrigadora (abrigos, calentadores de manos, calcetines) y comida. Las necesidades pueden haber cambiado; contáctalos primero.
